asset.name: Carousel
asset.description: The touch- and keyboard-operable sequence with native-feeling momentum, snapping, pagination indicators, autoplay safeguards, responsive item counts, and reduced-motion behavior.

requires.reason: Axis locking, velocity, and cancellation are shared.
Native scrolling and keyboard behavior are preserved.
Enter and exit lifecycle and reduced-motion collapse are owned once.

rationale: Autoplay is the accessibility hazard: any automatic advance must pause on hover, focus, and reduced-motion preference, and must never move content out from under a user who is reading it.
